name: telegram-approvals
description: Approval chat on Telegram: approval requests with inline buttons, replies as change requests, and /pending /status /pause /resume commands, over Bot API long polling (no public URL needed).

settings.label: Bot token
settings.help: From @BotFather → /newbot. Use a bot only for approvals, not one that publishes.

settings.label: Chat id
settings.help: Usually empty: save the token, then open the Connect link under Approval chats. A group id works too.

settings.label: Who may decide
settings.help: Telegram user ids, comma-separated. Empty: anyone in that chat.
